summary: Three women hiking the Capitol Creek Loop activated a locator beacon near Avalanche Lake; a 24-year-old with a leg injury and her two companions were airlifted by a HAATS helicopter; the injured hiker was evaluated and released at Aspen/Pitkin County Airport
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen, Colorado Army National Guard HAATS, Aspen Ambulance, Pitkin County Sheriff
notes: 18 volunteers involved; injury mechanism not reported in opened source; article published ~July 11, 2019 describes the 'Tuesday' event (July 9)
